description.value: Rasoi Fine Indian Cuisine is a South Surrey restaurant specializing in authentic Indian cooking since 2008, with chefs who bring over 20 years of experience to dishes prepared entirely from scratch. The menu spans tandoori specialties, curries, biryanis, and a strong selection of vegetarian options, with a liquor menu also available. Dine-in reservations, online ordering, and full catering services make it a viable stop for a sit-down meal on a longer touring route.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website fully corroborates OSM contact details (address, phone, website) and confirms an active sit-down Indian restaurant operating since 2008 with online ordering and catering. No mention of bike parking, bike racks, water refill, or washrooms appears anywhere in the website content, so those required criteria remain null. Vegetarian options (Cauliflower Tandoori, Paneer Tikka, Aloo Tikki, Vegetable Samosa) and takeout via 'Order Online' are confirmed from the website.
concerns: Website crawl returned the homepage content four times across four subpage slots, suggesting only the root page was successfully captured; deeper pages (About, Menu detail, Contact) were not retrieved, limiting amenity verification.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This is a legitimate, active restaurant well-suited to a Food & Drink listing, but none of the three required WWC criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) can be confirmed from available evidence. A brief on-the-ground or phone verification of bike parking and washroom availability would be sufficient to include it.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu includes multiple vegetarian dishes: Cauliflower Tandoori, Paneer Tikka, Aloo Tikki, Gol Gappa, Vegetable Samosa, and Mix Veggie Platter
